title: Open 18.5
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Third outing for the 11.6 / 12.5 ladder: seven minutes of thrusters at 100/65 lb and chest-to-bar pull-ups, 3-3, 6-6, 9-9 and up. Score is total reps. Scaled used 65/45 lb and jumping chin-over-bar pull-ups.

source.title: CrossFit Games Open 2018 – Workout 18.5

items.name: Ladder 3-6-9… in 7 min
items.note: AMRAP 7: keep adding 3 reps per round (21, 24…) until the clock runs out. Score = total reps.
